naming: The owner wrote 4D-SPC. This repository's established name is 4D-SCP (Four-Dimensional State Compression Processor). Records use 4D-SCP.

records.workload_identity: Versa UART image of scp4d_hybrid_ff, reduced configuration ADDR_W 8, cfg_D 256, percent 8, hold 1. Not the full v0.1.30 loop (35,438 TRELLIS_COMB).

input_conditions.summary: Held-out prefixes, not used to fit. Seed 9 fraction 0.01, two frames, 6 tokens. Seed 13 fraction 0.55, two frames, 282 tokens. OSS CAD Suite 20261118, Yosys 0.71+50 583f380c6, nextpnr-ecp5 0.11.1-103-ge811ba48, --um-45k, CABGA381, router2, --freq 100, seeds 1-5 serial.

baseline.summary: Earlier wrap_uart_ff median 24.44569206237793 MHz, critical path 40.906999967992306 ns, 6666/43848 TRELLIS_COMB.

experiment.summary: wrap_uart_ff_pipe removes the runtime token-width divide and reads payload bytes from block RAM one cycle after the address. Five LFE5UM-45F seeds, median seed 2.

build_provenance.summary: Procedure hash 3c90ab6f158e6cda1516b52b8437d5ed45fddb484f03871c1acd8a29fa7dd176 committed before the five-seed run. Measurement merge is pull request 31. The route pull request is 30.

implementation.summary: Median Fmax 53.61930465698242 MHz. 5/5 seeds routed. TRELLIS_COMB 2447/43848, TRELLIS_FF 1412, DP16KD 28/108. Packaged .bit, .svf, and .spi.bit for seed 2.

hardware_target.summary: Lattice ECP5 Versa, LFE5UM-45F, CABGA381. Pins from FPGA-EB-02021-2.4. Logic clock 20 MHz from the 100 MHz oscillator. Power needs real board.

validation.summary: Icarus file bridge is bit-exact on the seed 9 prefix (2 records) and the seed 13 prefix (135 records). The bitstream has not been loaded. Not yet physically validated.

outcome.summary: Reference implementation. Median 53.61930465698242 MHz is above the pre-registered 35-40 MHz window. No delay was added. Place-and-route and simulation only. Physical board programming, real workload throughput, and power measurement remain outstanding.
